title: APG semantic files overlay v0.1 (LLM-derived per-file enrichment)
description: Plan #15 Step A output. Per-file semantic summary, tags, complexity, and nodeType — supplemental to the structural tree-sitter graph and the hand-authored functionality.json overlay. Consumed by briefs and the visual dashboard. functionality.json taxonomy WINS on any conflict; semantic tags are supplemental only.

generatorVersion.description: Version of the file-summarizer that produced this output. Bump on any prompt/output-shape change.

graphHead.description: Git rev (commit SHA or symbolic HEAD) the inputs were drawn from. Used for stale detection.

inputSha.description: sha256 of the deterministic structural extract that was fed to the LLM. Lets consumers detect when inputs changed without re-running the LLM.

staleAfter.description: Optional advisory expiry — consumers should treat data as stale after this point even if graphHead still matches.

tags.description: 3-5 free-form bounded tags (typical: 'api-handler', 'data-model', 'test', 'ingest-pipeline', 'freshness-tracking'). Supplemental — must not contradict functionality.json feature membership.

complexity.description: Heuristic complexity rating. NOT a metric.

nodeType.description: One-of category. entry-point is NOT here — see entryPoint:boolean, a file can be both a category and an entry point.

entryPoint.description: True if this file is an entry point (main, CLI, server bootstrap, etc.). Orthogonal to nodeType.

languageNotes.description: Optional brief note about language-specific patterns or framework conventions present.

stats.description: Generator stats for observability — not load-bearing.
